dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible with high-contrast, thin light perimeters. The edges are irregular and jagged, creating a sharp gradient transition from a dark exterior fur tone to a light border, and back to a darker interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid pixel clusters. Most features exhibit internal gradients. A few small, asymmetrical clusters of low-intensity dark pixels are scattered in the interstices between the larger annuli, particularly in the lower-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal-central 'O' annuli form a wide-angled obtuse triangle. A secondary cluster of smaller, interlocking annuli in the mid-posterior region forms a dense, irregular polygonal network.
